title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Plan Agreement: General Terms
content:
## Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan agreement: general terms

**Terms in force.**

1. Where the program offers payment plans, a member whose balance due is at least the program's minimum plan balance may ask for a payment plan; the request is taken as a payment-plan service request and the plan starts when the member confirms it.
2. A payment plan may be set up only when the balance due is at least the program's minimum plan balance and the months requested do not exceed the program's maximum plan length.
3. While the plan is in good standing and the program exempts plan accounts from balance holds, a hold for balance over limit is released and new orders are not held for balance.

**Retired clauses, no longer in force.** The following former terms of this agreement are no longer in force and are superseded by the current basis; they are not applied:

- that the member may ask to pay the balance in up to the program's maximum plan length of monthly installments;
- that the installment amount is the balance due divided by the number of months chosen, rounded up to the cent;
- that the first installment is collected when the plan starts;
- that a missed installment ends the plan.

The program figures (whether a plan is offered, the minimum plan balance and the maximum plan length) remain those of the billing terms schedule.

### Set-up test

| Balance due compared with the minimum plan balance | Months requested compared with the maximum plan length | Plan may be set up |
|---|---|---|
| at least the minimum | not more than the maximum | Yes |
| below the minimum | any | No |
| any | more than the maximum | No |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, minimum plan balance 150.00, maximum plan length 6)

- Balance due 150.00, 6 months requested: may be set up.
- Balance due 149.99: may not be set up.
- Balance due 300.00, 7 months requested: may not be set up.

### Questions answered

- *When does the plan start?* When the member confirms it.
- *Does a plan help an account held for balance?* While the plan is in good standing on a program that exempts plan accounts from balance holds, the balance hold is released and new orders are not held for balance.
